author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: We need to align on the rollback path for the forecast service. The current automated revert is clean, but the manual override we discussed introduces a gap in our audit trail. I am willing to accept a manual rollback procedure, provided it is strictly logged and reviewed by a security officer before the next promotion week. This gives us the flexibility to handle edge cases without leaving the system in an ungoverned state. The trade off is clear: we lose the speed of an instant automated revert, but we gain a defensible record that satisfies our privacy and compliance obligations. I am not asking to remove the manual step, only to bind it to a formal review so we can justify the risk to the board.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts the loss of speed in automated reverts in exchange for a defensible audit trail to satisfy compliance obligations.
